008548: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_dereference_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId pointer, IrSourceRange source)
008549: {
008550:     if (pointer.value >= builder->function->value_count)
008551:     {
008552:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
008553:     }
008554:     if (c_ir_value_contains_label_provenance(builder, pointer))
008555:     {
008556:         builder->failure_message = S8("a label-provenance value may not be used as an addressable place");
008557:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
008558:     }
008559:     IrType* pointer_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[pointer.value].canonical_type);
008560:     if (!pointer_type || pointer_type->kind != IR_TYPE_POINTER)
008561:     {
008562:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
008563:     }
008564:     IrTypeId element = pointer_type->element_type;
008565:     IrValueId place = ir_function_add_value(builder->arena, builder->function,
008566:                                             (IrValue){
008567:                                                 .canonical_type = element,
008568:                                                 .definition = IR_INSTRUCTION_ID_INVALID,
008569:                                                 .category = IR_VALUE_PLACE,
008570:                                                 .is_read_only = builder->function->values[pointer.value].points_to_read_only,
008571:                                                 .is_volatile = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, element)->is_volatile,
008572:                                             });
008573:     IrSourceRange instruction_source = source;
008574:     IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_DEREFERENCE, element);
008575:     instruction.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
008576:     instruction.operands[0] = pointer;
008577:     instruction.operand_count = 1;
008578:     instruction.result = place;
008579:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
008580:     builder->function->values[place.value].definition = id;
008581:     return place;
008582: }

008584: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_decay_array(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrTypeId target_type, IrSourceRange source)
008585: {
008586:     if (value.value >= builder->function->value_count)
008587:     {
008588:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
008589:     }
008590:     IrType* array_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type);
008591:     IrType* pointer_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, target_type);
008592:     if (!array_type || array_type->kind != IR_TYPE_ARRAY || !pointer_type || pointer_type->kind != IR_TYPE_POINTER)
008593:     {
008594:         return value;
008595:     }
008596:     IrValueId zero = c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 0, false, (CToken){0});
008597:     IrValueId first = c_ir_emit_index_place(builder, value, zero, source);
008598:     IrValueId address = c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, first, array_type->element_type, source);
008599:     return c_ir_emit_cast(builder, address, target_type, source);
008600: }

008633: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_parameter(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CToken name, u32 argument_index, IrTypeId type, IrTypeId object_type, CEntityId entity)
008634: {
008635:     // A by-value parameter is a local object, not the caller's ABI slot.
008636:     // Carry its type alignment just as an ordinary declaration does: native
008637:     // lowering uses the place's alignment to reserve and materialize storage
008638:     // beyond the frame pointer's guaranteed alignment.
008639:     IrType* parameter_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, object_type);
008640:     u32 alignment = parameter_type ? parameter_type->layout.alignment : 0;
008641:     IrValueId place = c_ir_emit_local(builder, name, object_type, entity, alignment);
008642:     CIntegerIrLocal* local = c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, entity);
008643:     if (place.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !local)
008644:     {
008645:         return false;
008646:     }
008647:     local->is_parameter = true;
008648:     // The pointer an array parameter was adjusted to points at the element
008649:     // type, qualifiers included: `const struct timespec times[2]` yields a
008650:     // modifiable pointer to constant elements, so the read-only answer moves
008651:     // from the object to what it points to.
008652:     if (entity.value < builder->parse.entity_count)
008653:     {
008654:         CTypeId declared = builder->parse.entities[entity.value].type;
008655:         if (declared.value < builder->parse.type_count && builder->parse.types[declared.value].kind == C_TYPE_ARRAY &&
008656:             c_ir_c_type_is_read_only(builder, builder->parse.types[declared.value].element_type))
008657:         {
008658:             builder->function->values[place.value].points_to_read_only = true;
008659:         }
008660:     }
008661:     IrValueId value = c_ir_add_result(builder, type);
008662:     u64* immediate = arena_allocate(builder->arena, u64, 1);
008663:     immediate[0] = argument_index;
008664:     IrSourceRange argument_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, name);
008665:     IrInstruction argument = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_ARGUMENT, type);
008666:     argument.immediates = immediate;
008667:     argument.immediate_count = 1;
008668:     argument.result = value;
008669:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, argument, argument_source);
008670:     builder->function->values[value.value].definition = id;
008671:     bool stored = c_ir_emit_store(builder, local, value, argument_source);
008672:     if (stored)
008673:     {
008674:         c_ir_mark_local_read_only(builder, local);
008675:     }
008676:     return stored;
008677: }

008679: // The constant rows every integer literal becomes, taking the source range
008680: // directly: the fall-off of `main` has no token of its own to name, only the
008681: // declaration's range.
008682: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_integer_value_at(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u64 value, bool is_negative, IrSourceRange instruction_source,
008683:                                                        IrTypeId type)
008684: {
008685:     IrValueId result = c_ir_add_result(builder, type);
008686:     u64* immediate = arena_allocate(builder->arena, u64, 1);
008687:     immediate[0] = value;
008688:     IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_CONSTANT_INTEGER, type);
008689:     instruction.immediates = immediate;
008690:     instruction.immediate_count = 1;
008691:     instruction.immediate_is_negative = is_negative;
008692:     instruction.result = result;
008693:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
008694:     builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
008695:     return result;
008696: }
